title: じんこうとじんこう (Jinkou to Jinkou)
description: A clever wordplay title: 人工 (artificial) and 人口 (population) sound the same but mean different things. At the science museum, Sota learns about artificial intelligence, artificial satellites, and how Japan's population is changing — told through exhibits, a friendly robot guide, and a curious child's questions.
author: オリジナル
